mapper.select: SELECT funding_day, SUM(payments) AS payments, SUM(paid) AS paid, SUM(recharged) AS recharged FROM ( SELECT CAST(paid_time AS DATE) AS funding_day, COUNT(*) AS payments, SUM(amount) AS paid, 0.00 AS recharged FROM pay_payment p WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pay_wallet_recharge r WHERE r.recharge_no=p.order_no) AND paid_time >= #{from} AND paid_time < #{until} GROUP BY CAST(paid_time AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(paid_time AS DATE) AS funding_day, 0 AS payments, 0.00 AS paid, SUM(pay_price) AS recharged FROM pay_wallet_recharge WHERE status IN ('PAID','REFUNDING','REFUNDED') AND paid_time >= #{from} AND paid_time < #{until} GROUP BY CAST(paid_time AS DATE) ) daily GROUP BY funding_day ORDER BY funding_day
